sync_policy: Explicit official release tags only; never merge upstream/main. Update this manifest and run scripts/verify_vzgpt_release.py.
extensions: merge_state API in five session services, with regression tests.
No runtime index builds on existing tables outside SQLite.
NodeTool failures and invalid input are returned to the model as in 2.9.0.
NodeTool results with skip_summarization are not appended as visible text.
Tool sub-branch events stay in the calling agent's history as in 2.9.0.
Session State keeps the 2.12.0 semantics: no container snapshots on read and no implicit recording of in-place nested writes (upstream ce2fdc5aa, 662b0175a; still part of v2.14.0).
